study: Yomitsugi publication extension: singleton-template population validation
status: Internal analysis plan fixed before new simulations; not an external preregistration

original_reanalysis.interpretation: Post hoc reanalysis; replicate-level time averages are the units for intervals.

unlimited.update: All parents attempt once; parents and offspring survive independently. Exact aggregate multinomial/binomial law; no resource or population cap.
unlimited.outputs: Unconditional count means, complete trajectories, exact expectation and finite-time extinction probabilities. Extinct replicates retained.

finite_resource.update: Unmodified vendored original snapshot sweep and kernel; one fixed template; independent seeds by case and replicate.
finite_resource.extinction_handling: Retain every replicate. Report zero-filled fractions after extinction, conditional-on-occupied fractions, and occupied fractions separately.
finite_resource.interpretation: The dominant eigenvector is a mean-field composition candidate, not an exact finite-population stationary law.

statistics.interval: Student-t 95% intervals over independent replicate means; Wilson 95% intervals for binary outcomes
